name: The Mommy Prometheus/prototype
source:
a story about the day you were born. 
[from [url=https://thursdayrain.itch.io/themommyprometheus] itch.io [/url] ]

A first person experience about being made into something that isn't yours. A creation awakes in a jar, longing for the love of their creator, to see her face. Its master, or more fittingly, their mother; builds their new body one piece at a time. This body doesn't fit and never will, but it doesn't matter. Not when mother knows best.
